family: All Boolean g in dimensions 0 through 3, balanced by a fresh character; selected disjoint tensor copies of constants, dictator, AND2, majority3 and addressing1
parameter_domain: Exhaust all 278 base functions with m=1. Selected five base functions with m=2. No other tensor exponent or dimension.
case_count: 278 character-balanced sources plus five two-copy sources
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms and Fraction Fourier probabilities; exact formal rational log atoms. Identities checked exactly, without floating entropies or transcendental signs.
memory_estimate: Less than 50 MB; largest truth table 128 entries
proof_role: Checks R(F_m)=m B(g) and I(F_m)=mI(g)+1. The m-to-infinity equal-optimal-constant bridge is proved analytically, not extrapolated from m=1,2.
